d5d3e55a: What is Walter White's actual job at the start of the series?
Walter White teaches high school chemistry in Albuquerque: a brilliant man pushed into the drug trade by cancer and debt.
32f4b7b3: What is the name of Walter's former student and partner in the drug trade?
Jesse Pinkman is a small-time dealer going nowhere. Their unlikely partnership forms one of the most memorable duos in American drama.
5bd33df6: What is Walter White's alias in the drug trade?
Heisenberg is Walter's alias, a reference to the uncertainty principle. The name becomes a legend in the underworld.
24766d6e: What is the distinctive color of Walter's meth?
Blue Sky is Walter's exceptionally pure methamphetamine, recognizable by its blue tint and its 99.1% purity.
aeadc250: What is the name of Walter's brother-in-law, a DEA agent?
Hank Schrader hunts Heisenberg without knowing he is his own brother-in-law. His death is one of the hardest moments of the series.
47a77904: What is the name of Walter White's son, who has a disability?
Walter White Jr. (who calls himself Flynn) has cerebral palsy. He ends up hating his father when the truth comes out.
3cd681fd: What is the name of the crooked lawyer who helps Walter and Jesse?
Saul Goodman (real name Jimmy McGill) is the comic, corrupt lawyer. His popularity led to the spin-off Better Call Saul.
0891653f: Which restaurant chain serves as Gus Fring's front?
Los Pollos Hermanos is Gustavo Fring's fast-food chain: a flawless restaurateur in public, a drug lord in secret.
1f0cb7be: In which city is Breaking Bad set?
Albuquerque, New Mexico: its deserts, its sun and its particular atmosphere are almost characters in their own right.
113fe662: How are bodies disposed of using the method shown in the series?
Hydrofluoric acid (HF) is used to dissolve bodies. Jesse makes the mistake of using a bathtub, which dramatically eats through the floor.
09382fd4: What is the name of Walter White's wife?
Skyler White is Walter's wife. She gradually discovers her husband's double life and tries to protect their family.
fb6ace81: What is the name of Gus Fring's fixer, a former police officer?
Mike Ehrmantraut is a former Philadelphia cop turned fixer: meticulous, calm and morally complex. His story is explored in Better Call Saul.
2ed854b6: Which front business does Walter use to launder money?
A1A Car Wash is the car wash Walter and Skyler buy to launder the drug money.
89b6f1f4: What is the name of Gus Fring's talented and harmless chemist?
Gale Boetticher is the chemist hired by Gus Fring. Walter has Jesse kill him to make sure he remains indispensable.
41f0e04a: How do Walter and Jesse steal a large amount of methylamine in season 5?
They buy it from the cartel
Walter, Jesse, Mike and Todd pull off a daring train heist to siphon methylamine, one of the most tense episodes.
42728761: What is Gus Fring's fate in the series?
He is arrested by the DEA
Killed by a bomb in a nursing home
Gus Fring is killed by a bomb in Tio Salamanca's wheelchair. The half-face shot is one of the most iconic scenes of the series.
3ddaf6f8: Which book reveals Walter's identity to Hank?
Walt Whitman's Leaves of Grass: an inscription from Gale to “my other favorite W.W.” lets Hank make the fatal connection.
f9197038: Which episode is often ranked the greatest TV episode of all time?
“Ozymandias” (S5E14), directed by Rian Johnson, is one of the highest-rated episodes on IMDb, with Bryan Cranston at the top of his game.
65897004: What does Walter finally confess to Skyler in the last episode?
“I did it for me. I liked it. I was good at it.” Walter finally admits he acted out of pride, not for his family.
e999be08: What is the title of the last episode of Breaking Bad?
“Felina” is an anagram of “finale” and a nod to Marty Robbins's song “El Paso”. It also reads as Fe, Li, Na: iron, lithium, sodium, or blood, meth and tears.
4b113672: Bryan Cranston plays Walter White and won three consecutive Emmys for the role, then a fourth. His shift from Malcolm in the Middle to Walt is a landmark transformation.
2ad70f23: What is the name of Jesse's girlfriend who dies of an overdose in front of Walter?
Jane Margolis is Jesse's girlfriend. Walter lets her die of an overdose to keep Jesse under his control, a decision that haunts both men.
9d229c2a: What is the title of the sequel film to Breaking Bad?
El Camino (2019) follows Jesse right after the end of Breaking Bad. He finally leaves for Alaska under a new identity.
f2fba6e1: What is Saul Goodman's real name?
Jimmy McGill is Saul Goodman's real name. Better Call Saul shows his transformation from struggling lawyer into criminal.
5a484932: What is the name of the clandestine industrial lab beneath the laundry?
The Superlab is the industrial lab Gus Fring built beneath Lavandería Brillante, state of the art for large-scale meth production.
78205160: Aaron Paul plays Jesse Pinkman and won 3 Emmy Awards. His journey from small-time dealer to broken man is one of the show's most heartbreaking arcs.
710e19c3: What is Jesse's joyful exclamation about science and technology?
“Yeah, bitch! Magnets!” is Jesse's cry after using a giant electromagnet to wipe out computer evidence.
d58f58ef: How does Walter force Gretchen and Elliott to give the money to his family?
With fake hitmen (Badger and Skinny Pete)
Walter threatens Gretchen and Elliott Schwartz with “hitmen” who are really Badger and Skinny Pete holding laser pointers. Heisenberg's final trick.
8282de23: Which chemistry company did Walter co-found before Breaking Bad?
Walter co-founded Gray Matter Technologies, then sold his share for $5,000 and missed out on a fortune. That resentment fuels his pride.
2600dde9: Which character says “I am not in danger. I am the danger”?
“I am not in danger, Skyler. I am the danger.” The line marks Walter's complete transformation into Heisenberg.
e768e024: Who is the showrunner and creator of Breaking Bad?
Vince Gilligan created Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul. He previously worked on The X-Files.
3f58d862: What is the name of the wheelchair-bound cartel patriarch who communicates only with a bell?
Hector Salamanca (Tio) sacrifices himself to kill Gus Fring by setting off the bomb hidden in his wheelchair.
56ef07d4: What is the name of the laundry that fronts for the Superlab?
Lavandería Brillante is the industrial laundry that serves as cover for Gus Fring's Superlab.
92a1bf54: How many seasons does Breaking Bad have?
Breaking Bad has 5 seasons, aired from 2008 to 2013 on AMC. It is often cited as one of the greatest TV series ever made.
50ddcaf6: What is Jesse Pinkman's fate in El Camino?
In El Camino (2019), Jesse escapes to Alaska under a new identity: a hard-won freedom after everything he went through.
b51f2c77: What is the name of Hank Schrader's wife, Skyler's sister?
Marie Schrader is Hank's wife and Skyler's sister, a kleptomaniac with a passion for purple who eventually learns the truth about Heisenberg.
43fd4bfb: What is the name of the Aryan group working with Todd in season 5?
Jack Welker's gang of white supremacists becomes the final antagonist. Todd, their protégé, embodies the banality of evil.
cade0fdd: How does Heisenberg's empire finally end?
Walter dies after freeing Jesse and wiping out his enemies
Walter returns to Albuquerque, wipes out Jack's gang, frees Jesse and dies of his wounds in the neo-Nazis' lab.
4f52b178: What illness does Walter White have at the start of the series?
Walter White is diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer in season 1, which triggers his decision to cook methamphetamine.
52b3b5f3: How does Walter White let Jane Margolis die?
He lets her choke on her vomit without intervening
He pushes her off the balcony
Walter watches Jane choke on her vomit when he could have turned her over: a cold decision to keep Jesse under control.
0cc0db6d: How does Walter kill Emilio at their first meeting?
During the cook in the RV, Walter throws red phosphorus into boiling water. The phosphine gas it releases kills Emilio.
06fdf2af: What does Walter use to kill Jack's men at the end?
An automatic machine gun in his car trunk
Walter rigs an M60 in the trunk of his car on an automatic sweeping mechanism: an engineer's solution to wipe out Jack's compound.
c42b6510: Which scientist does Walter's alias refer to?
Werner Heisenberg (1901-1976) is the German physicist who formulated the uncertainty principle. Walter picks the name out of intellectual irony.
f3769dfb: How many millions of dollars does Walter amass at his peak?
At his peak, Walter has around $80 million in cash, stored in barrels buried in the New Mexico desert.
c44c3c1b: Which actor plays Gus Fring in Breaking Bad?
Giancarlo Esposito plays Gustavo Fring with masterful coldness. He returns to the role in Better Call Saul.
ae6643ca: How does Hector Salamanca communicate from his wheelchair?
Hector Salamanca, paralyzed, communicates by ringing a bell. This detail plays a decisive role in Gus Fring's death.
6690651f: What is the first name of Jesse Pinkman's younger brother mentioned in the series?
Jake is Jesse's younger brother, a model student their parents favor over their elder son.
835c9196: How pure is Walter's meth according to his own analysis?
Walter's Blue Sky is 99.1% pure, a level never seen before in the trade, which builds Heisenberg's reputation across the American West.
299ecea6: Which of these Better Call Saul characters also appears in Breaking Bad?
Of these four, only Mike Ehrmantraut appears in Breaking Bad, where he plays a crucial role as Gus's and then Walt's fixer.
72733fab: How does Jesse escape Jack's compound at the end of the series?
He is freed by the police
He drives off in Todd's car
After the shootout, Walter frees Jesse, who flees screaming at the wheel of Todd's car, the famous El Camino.
76d86d39: What is Skyler White's profession before the drug money?
Skyler is a bookkeeper, skills she later uses to manage the money laundering through A1A Car Wash.
19ccd174: Who is Lydia Rodarte-Quayle in the series?
Madrigal's logistics manager, supplying Gus and then Walt
The boss of the Mexican cartel
Lydia Rodarte-Quayle is a logistics executive at Madrigal Electromotive. She enables the international distribution of Walter's product.
92281248: How does Walter poison Lydia at the end of the series?
Walter puts ricin in the stevia that Lydia pours into her tea at their last meeting.
34bf9397: What is Todd's fate at the end of the series?
Jesse strangles Todd with his chains right after Walter's machine gun goes off: revenge for Andrea's death.
9620b8b6: Which pest control company serves as cover for Walter, Jesse and Mike in season 5?
Vamonos Pest is the fumigation company Walter, Jesse and Mike use to set up temporary meth labs in houses tented for treatment.
ef11375d: Who does Todd shoot right after the train heist?
Drew Sharp, a boy on a bike, is killed by Todd after witnessing the train heist: the first clear sign of Todd's cold psychopathy.
89949436: Who is Saul Goodman's “supplier” for new identities?
Ed Galbraith, officially a vacuum cleaner repairman, arranges complete disappearances with a new identity.
